svg.aria-label: FORGE — AI agent · Meta AI Hackathon
svg.title: FORGE — AI agent · Meta AI Hackathon
svg.desc: Multimodal engineering agent for mechanical systems. The LLM observes, models and proposes redesigns; deterministic Python tools compute gear ratios, RPM and constraints, so the model never does the math it reasons about.
